name: Merge materials (p374)
description: p374's verification scene: the palette ruinsPalette (four STANDARD materials) on eight meshes, drawn as eight entities with the members' own materials (REFERENCE), as one geometry with a group per member drawn by the four materials (BAKED, the control), and as one geometry with a per-vertex aekMatIndex drawn by the palette's merge material (MERGED) and by one made from a copy of its data with SKIP slots (SKIP). Orthographic, so every variant shown alone at the origin renders the same pixels: window.__mergeMaterials.show(variant).
